unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no row for this model found. The page text names Qwen only through an older model (Qwen 3 32B) and the leaderboard table is rendered by script, so a row is not ruled out
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: Artificial Analysis's coding-agent data (read 2026-10-03) holds a Claude Code run for Qwen3.8 Max only; none for this model

METR 50% time horizon: METR's page (last updated 2026-05-08) mentions only the generic 'Qwen models' (added 2025-06-27) and its chart values are not in the page text, so an entry for this model is not ruled out
retires: no retirement date published; QwenCloud's 2026-10-10 retirement notices (both read as images) name this model as the replacement for older Max models, not as retiring
released: QwenCloud's changelog and Alibaba's launch post say 2026-05-21 (the dated snapshot is 2026-05-20); Artificial Analysis and Epoch AI say 2026-05-19

max_output: the QwenCloud model page says 131K (also with thinking), the QwenCloud model table says 64k, The Batch's write-up says 64,000 and the launch post's OpenClaw configuration uses 65,536; 131,072 kept

modalities: the bare id's model page lists text input only; QwenCloud's changelog says the 2026-06-08 snapshot added image understanding, and no page read says which snapshot the bare id now points to

reasoning: QwenCloud documents thinking on by default and switchable (hybrid), with thinking_budget; its API reference documents reasoning_effort levels for the Qwen3.8 models and not for Qwen3.7, so no levels or default are recorded
system_card: none; the maker publishes no system card or model card for this model, and the launch post's promised technical report was not found
access: OpenRouter's listing was read in its models API (class A); Model Studio availability and the Claude Code, OpenClaw and Qwen Code set-ups rest on the launch post

benchmarks: Alibaba's comparison tables are images; the values recorded here come from the post's text where it gives them and from the figure where it does not, and no maker table of the full result set is published as text
size: parameter count and architecture are not published; Artificial Analysis and Epoch AI list the size as unknown
